fields.value: Read retained evidence in etude report without re-deriving matchups from the current source

Problem: `etude report <experiment file>` builds the page by calling the file's `eval(state)` and assembling the tournament with its held eval runs (`src/etude/eval/records.py` `assemble`). When the experiment derives its matchups or environment from the current source digest (manabot `experiments/tla_frontier.py` `_source()` hashes every `manabot/*.py`), any later revision disagrees with the held runs and the report is refused with `tournament_conflict` (409), even though only retained results are being read. Observed 2026-11-12 on manabot MTG-274: the frontier file from a later revision is refused; the page could only be rebuilt through a wrapper file with `report()` and no `eval`, over scoped run prefixes. The unscoped `--source r2://manabot/jobs` scan also ran over 15 min and used 3.9 GB.

Outcome: reading held evidence for a report does not require `eval(state)` to agree with the current source digest. A finished experiment's page rebuilds from a later revision of its file, drawing exactly what its held runs recorded. Scheduling new games (`etude eval`) keeps the conflict check.

Related: EXP-52 (pool games across execution setups), EXP-53 (self curve scores the later side only). Do not fix this with a manabot `_source` workaround or by editing frozen experiment files.
